hooks.command: f=$(uv run python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or '')"); case "$f" in *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run ruff check "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; uv run python -c "import json,sys; sys.exit(1 if json.load(sys.stdin).get('stop_hook_active') else 0)" || exit 0; git status --porcelain | grep -q '\.py$' || exit 0; uv run pytest -q >&2 || exit 2
